caption.en: A source-bound routing specification. The efficacy question stays separate.
caption.zh: 源绑定路由规范，效果问题单独验证。

caption.en: Historical contract counts; not training benefit.
caption.zh: 历史合同计数，不是训练收益。

caption.en: Retained prototype semantics versus the contract.
caption.zh: 保留原型的语义与合同要求。

caption.en: Zero variance permits source fitting, not task success.
caption.zh: 零方差允许源拟合，不保证任务成功。

caption.en: Low global loss and terminal failure coexist.
caption.zh: 低全局损失与终局失败并存。

caption.en: Signed contributions are not causal shares.
caption.zh: 有符号贡献不是因果份额。

caption.en: Both objectives fail the registered neural gate.
caption.zh: 两种目标均未通过登记的神经可行性门。

caption.en: New execution does not rewrite the old pilot.
Two binding repairs are jointly necessary.
caption.zh: 两处绑定修复需要共同完成。

caption.en: Different inputs and memory; a separate study.
caption.zh: 输入与记忆不同，属于独立研究。
参考任务结果，不是 SEEC 效果。

caption.en: Budgets and endpoints are reported separately.

caption.zh: 不跨任务或跨边界合并。

caption.en: Better source fit still fails closed-loop execution.
caption.zh: 更好的源拟合仍未成功闭环执行。

title.zh: 优化器与神经拟合对照

caption.en: Assisted execution is not teacher-free success.
caption.zh: 辅助执行不是无教师成功。
更强的无证书对照仍然成功。

caption.en: The threshold does not identify certificate value.
caption.zh: 阈值不能识别证书价值。

caption.en: A known-model feasibility witness; no neural training.
caption.zh: 已知模型的可行性见证，没有神经训练。

text.en: Plans, role separation, source lineage, target weights and restoration evidence.
text.zh: 计划、角色隔离、源血缘、目标权重与恢复证据。

text.en: Candidate replay, source-support rivals and observable-feedback controls.
text.zh: 候选重放、源支持对照与可见反馈控制。

text.en: Still missing under the declared fresh-window boundary. Previous routes remain stopped.
text.zh: 在登记的新窗口边界下仍未关闭，原学习器路线保持停止。

text.en: Needs informative paired learner outcomes against strong certificate-free controls.
text.zh: 需要能区分强无证书对照的、有信息量的配对学习器结果。

text.en: Design a new prospectively frozen study. Preserve the stopped studies, window boundary and terminal thresholds.
text.zh: 设计全新的事前冻结研究，保留旧研究的停止结果、窗口边界与终局阈值。

title.zh: 关闭学习器可行性缺口

text.en: Construct a preregistered intervention with different predictions for source-support rules, feedback control and source-bound certification.
text.zh: 构造预登记的干预，让源支持规则、反馈控制与源绑定认证产生可区分的预测。

title.zh: 区分证据作用与成功启发式

text.en: Independent conditions and contact restoration need their own evidence. Lift E4 remains failed; real-robot and VLA results are not claimed.
text.zh: 独立条件与接触恢复需要各自证据。Lift E4 仍失败，不主张真机或 VLA 结果。

description.en: Five preregistered controls on the unchanged carrier. Estimate hidden gain from the observed response, correct position, then brake.
description.zh: 在不改变载体的条件下预登记五个控制器：从可见响应估计增益，修正位置，再制动。

outcome.zh: 可见增益反馈 120/120；名义增益对照 40/120

scope.en: Known-model, hand-designed control. 600 records on reused conditions, zero training. Not a learned SEEC effect.
scope.zh: 使用已知动力学的手工控制器。600 条记录、复用条件、零训练，不是学得的 SEEC 效果。

title.en: Can visible feedback rescue a failed fixed action?
title.zh: 可见反馈能否挽救失败的固定动作？

description.en: Paired SEEC, raw success-only and matched random-deletion views; the deletion arm crosses five deletion seeds with five training seeds.
description.zh: 配对比较 SEEC、raw success-only 与匹配随机删除视图；删除臂交叉五个删除种子和五个训练种子。

outcome.zh: 选定检查点的留出 rollout：0/1715

scope.en: 35 optimizer runs, five paired training seeds. Historical replay defects also prevent an efficacy comparison. Main study deferred.
scope.zh: 35 次优化运行，统计单位为五个配对训练种子。历史重放缺陷也阻止了效果比较，主实验暂缓。

title.zh: 五种子学习器可行性 pilot

description.en: A separate probe-only pool compares seven-output and active-two-output objectives under a common BCRNN initialization and budget.
description.zh: 独立的 probe-only 池，在相同 BCRNN 初始化与预算下比较七维输出和有效二维输出目标。

scope.en: Three paired seeds, two objectives, 6000 updates each. The registered learner route stopped; no held-out calls.
scope.zh: 三个配对种子、两种目标，每次 6000 更新。登记的学习器路线已停止，没有留出评测调用。

title.zh: 无冲突的干净输入神经对照

description.en: Source-fitted nearest-window control succeeds after filtering. A minimum-norm action-mode rule without role or certificate inputs matches it.
description.zh: 源数据拟合的最近窗口控制在过滤后成功；不读取角色或证书的最小范数动作模式规则取得相同成功结果。

scope.en: 24 source and 96 reused diagnostic conditions. A finite control result, not neural efficacy or certificate necessity.
scope.zh: 24 个源条件与 96 个复用诊断条件。仅为有限控制结果，不是神经策略效果或证书必要性。

title.en: Finite retrieval and a stronger certificate-free rival
title.zh: 有限检索与更强的无证书对照

description.en: Four registered episode-weight settings change the majority rule. A frequency-neutral physical-null rule succeeds throughout.
description.zh: 四组登记的 episode 权重改变多数规则选择；不依赖票频的物理零动作先验规则在所有设置下均成功。

outcome.zh: 多数规则在 probe 比例 0.25 处切换

scope.en: 360 rollouts, zero updates. More reweighting of this archive cannot separate certificate benefit from strong support-only priors.
scope.zh: 360 次 rollout，零更新。继续对同一档案重加权，无法区分证书收益与强源支持先验。

title.en: Does a vote-frequency threshold identify certificate value?
title.zh: 票频阈值能否识别证书的价值？

description.en: A fresh-window MLP compares Adam and LBFGS in a separately registered, bounded optimizer diagnostic.
description.zh: 独立预登记、有预算上限的优化诊断，用新窗口 MLP 比较 Adam 与 LBFGS。

outcome.zh: 两种优化器的闭环成功均为零

scope.en: Three paired seeds. Improved source fit under LBFGS did not meet the unchanged terminal tolerance. Stopping decision retained.
scope.zh: 三个配对种子。LBFGS 改善源拟合，但未达到不变的终局容差，停止决定保留。

title.en: Lower source error is not closed-loop success
title.zh: 源误差下降不等于闭环成功

description.en: The opt-in v3.3 contract binds the actual direct reset state and each probe's visibility-evidence identity. Each repair is necessary in the reproduced integration defect.
description.zh: 可选 v3.3 合同绑定真实 direct 恢复状态与每条 probe 的可见性证据身份；复现的集成缺陷需要两处共同修复。

scope.en: 162 new physical trajectories; 1104 admitted targets. A technical contract check; historical certificates and pilot outcomes remain unchanged.
scope.zh: 162 条新物理轨迹，1104 个准入目标。仅为技术合同检查，不改写历史证书或 pilot 结局。

title.zh: 源绑定重放与严格准入

description.en: Official Can-task reference learners run with their disclosed memory and evaluation boundaries. They are neither SEEC arms nor substitutes for its failed window-policy controls.
description.zh: 官方 Can 任务参考学习器按其记忆与评测边界运行。它们不是 SEEC 实验臂，也不能替代失败的窗口策略对照。

outcome.en: Different task and memory boundary; no pooling
outcome.zh: 任务与记忆边界不同，不合并比较

scope.en: Reference learning records and budget curves are reported independently of the engineered Planar carrier.
scope.zh: 参考学习记录与预算曲线独立于为机制测试构造的 Planar 载体报告。

title.zh: 单独报告的公开任务学习器参考

text.en: Pre-execution freeze, 600 trajectories, five controls and all failures retained. Appendix R and Figure 18 separate feedback feasibility from learned benefit.
text.zh: 先冻结再执行，600 条轨迹、五个控制器，全部失败保留。附录 R 与图 18 区分反馈可行性与学习收益。

title.zh: 可见反馈见证与构造性证明

text.en: The vote-frequency switch is predicted exactly, while a stronger certificate-free rule continues to succeed. The overview now begins at the identical-input conflict.
text.zh: 精确预测票频切换，但更强的无证书规则仍成功。主图重新从同输入冲突展开。

title.zh: 票频先验研究与主图重绘

text.en: Opt-in v3.3 admission restores the intended row counts. It does not replace historical replay records or lift learning stop decisions.
text.zh: 可选 v3.3 准入恢复了预期行数；它不替换历史重放记录，也不解除学习停止决定。

title.en: Source-bound physical execution closes two consumer defects
title.zh: 源绑定物理执行关闭两处消费侧缺陷

text.en: Target consistency and improved source loss do not produce successful neural closed-loop execution in these bounded studies.
text.zh: 在这些有界研究中，目标一致与源损失改善仍未产生成功的神经闭环执行。

title.en: Clean-input and optimizer controls retain negative outcomes
title.zh: 干净输入与优化器对照保留阴性结果

text.en: All selected pilot endpoints fail. Results are retained without relabeling, checkpoint reselection or pooling pilot data into a main study.
text.zh: 所有选定 pilot 端点失败。保留结果，不重新标注、不重选检查点，也不把 pilot 数据并入主实验。

title.en: All-arms-at-floor rule defers the main study
title.zh: 所有臂处于地板，按规则暂缓主实验

text.en: v1 was smoke. v2 stopped because neither source teacher had terminal success and no V existed. v3 introduces explicit termination and an independent verifier; later method revisions are disclosed.
text.zh: v1 是冒烟；v2 因两个源教师均无终局成功且没有 V 而停止。v3 引入明确终止与独立验证器，后续方法修订如实披露。

title.en: From smoke to a terminally defined carrier
title.zh: 从冒烟到终局定义明确的载体
